paragraphs.source_en: Tonight there is a half-rising waning moon in the sky. I want to take her hand, walk with her in many places by moonlight— the light is just as clear, I said—full or incomplete. In the garden there remains one magnolia tree still in bloom. She has such a fondness for flowers, and I love to watch her tenderness toward them— the fragrance is the same, she said, among full blossoms and fallen ones. In the dense shade there is a nightingale out of season. She has taken on the autumn chill, and is no longer as radiant as before— She is near death, she said, but I do not regret my infatuated devotion! But this nightingale, this tree of flowers, this half moon— I alone murmur to myself, before my own shadow— She is there, ah, why sorrow, wither, and fall into incompleteness? Written on September 10, 1925.

units.source_en: Tonight there is a half-rising waning moon in the sky.
units.source_zh: 今晚天上有半輪的下弦月；

units.source_en: I want to take her hand, walk with her in many places by moonlight— the light is just as clear, I said—full or incomplete.
units.source_zh:
我想攜著她的手，

往明月多處走──

一樣是清光，我說，圓滿或殘缺。

units.source_en: In the garden there remains one magnolia tree still in bloom.
units.source_zh: 園裏有一樹開剩的玉蘭花；

units.source_en: She has such a fondness for flowers, and I love to watch her tenderness toward them— the fragrance is the same, she said, among full blossoms and fallen ones.
units.source_zh:
她有的是愛花癖，

我愛看她的憐惜──

一樣是芬芳，她說，滿花與殘花。

units.source_en: In the dense shade there is a nightingale out of season.
units.source_zh: 濃陰裏有一隻過時的夜鶯；

units.source_en: She has taken on the autumn chill, and is no longer as radiant as before— She is near death, she said, but I do not regret my infatuated devotion!

ja.t: るさはない。 もうすぐ

units.source_zh:
她受了秋涼，

不如從前瀏亮──

快死了，她說，但我不悔我的癡情！

units.source_en: But this nightingale, this tree of flowers, this half moon— I alone murmur to myself, before my own shadow— She is there, ah, why sorrow, wither, and fall into incompleteness?

ja.t: はそこにいる――ああ、なぜ

units.source_zh:
但這鶯，這一樹花，這半輪月──

我獨自沈吟，

對著我的身影──

她在那裏，啊，為什麼傷悲，凋謝，殘缺？
一九二五年九月十日作

paragraphs.source_zh:
今晚天上有半輪的下弦月；

我想攜著她的手，

往明月多處走──

一樣是清光，我說，圓滿或殘缺。

園裏有一樹開剩的玉蘭花；

她有的是愛花癖，

我愛看她的憐惜──

一樣是芬芳，她說，滿花與殘花。

濃陰裏有一隻過時的夜鶯；

她受了秋涼，

不如從前瀏亮──

快死了，她說，但我不悔我的癡情！

但這鶯，這一樹花，這半輪月──

我獨自沈吟，

對著我的身影──

她在那裏，啊，為什麼傷悲，凋謝，殘缺？

一九二五年九月十日作
